# Temporary Directory follows the current system

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

The existing native Path service obtains the current system temporary directory. The expected path is computed at execution time, so this example remains portable between users and machines.

## What this example demonstrates

The existing native Path service obtains the current system temporary directory. The expected path is computed at execution time, so this example remains portable between users and machines.
